name: audit-and-fix
description: Audit an existing tree and repair only what the audit blocks: bootstrap the toolchain, run the project's own checks into a machine verdict, review the diff against its intent, then fix under a bounded gate.
pattern_rationale: Four ordered stages over one tree, each consuming the previous verdict; there is nothing to fan out over because an audit has one subject, and the fix's verifier loop is a bounded gate rather than a second pattern.

project_dir.description: directory the toolchain lives in and the check commands run against — a var, never a literal, so auditing a second service cannot bootstrap the first one's tree

scope_folder.description: folder holding the intent the audit checks against (an SDD feature folder, a spec directory); the reviewer cites it and the fixer is bound by it

diff_base.description: diff base the audit reads the tree against (a sha, a tag, or a release ref)

gates.description: check commands, one per line; {file} is replaced with the path under verification. Empty means the audit reports clean

verify.description: verify commands the fixer runs over its own repair, one per line

guardrails.description: project spec / constitution paths the reviewer cites blockers against
